findings.summary: Archived matrix static contains/absent assertions show decision traceability, not end-to-end runtime UX, privacy isolation, mobile PWA or current production delivery. The dated `published_source` and `RETIRED_NOT_REQUIRED` labels are historical and do not waive risk-appropriate present-day evidence.

Current public acceptance source uses explicit roaster URL test cases, nine-request budget, local admission stub, redacted capture and fail-on-required mismatch. Official pages and regex expectations drift; a skipped or stale-source acceptance cannot be credited as PASS. Requires #33 source-specific proof before editing.

Product JSON offer-comparison diagnostic uses catch{} for malformed optional comparison, and JSON fixture uses invalid_json marker. This might limit diagnostics without masking overall source-extraction parity in proven cases; no observed failing fixture or justified change.
